steps: Create one FairAdmission and one HostMemoryGate per coordinator, not one per group or episode.
Register all truly pending plan slot IDs before group threads. Remove environment/cash exclusions; update healthy/can_dispatch outside gate lock.
Wire queue generation_limit to ceiling(group). Map AdmissionDeferred only when no claim/API exists; retain the same identity pending, never sample a replacement.

Call enter(row,stop_event), then require_start(row) immediately before the first owned actor claim. On proven unentered deferral use leave(row,unentered=True); on started closure leave(row). ready(row) only after controller initialization.
Control read is from the new frozen plan path. A drain preserves existing model/score work and must prevent new actor creation; explicitly record pending inventory for owner handoff.

Construct parked,baseline_ref with HostMemoryGate.capture_initial(slot,snapshot,pair,folder,name=baseline-snapshot,...); use parked.file_policy for controller config and retain no full baseline variable during model execution.

After writer quiescence, run the complete controller export, extraction, terminal snapshot, source comparison and candidate export in gate.run_heavy(slot,label,callback); load parked baseline only inside that callback, return small receipts. Also route failure-retention archive paths through the same executor.
Do not capture an already loaded baseline in the callback or use generic scope.load caching for whole source trees. Keep original complete-byte hashes and archive roundtrip verification.
After all generation/scoring owners finish call gate.close() (wait=True,cancel_futures=False). Preserve errors and candidate evidence; no automatic model retry.

New scope must freeze managerMemoryHigh30GiB/Max32GiB; read manager_pressure only for new admission. Heavy cleanup proceeds even when pressure is high, because it releases memory. Do not modify the old live guard.
actual_runtime_validation_still_required: new runner/episode CPU binding and host authority tests after root builds exact future deployment; no real resource start implied
